policies.title: Gambian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places Gambia in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval before a short visitor journey unless the separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Gambian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the authorized-visa application and listed documents before travel to the competent Panamanian consulate; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted and carry all required supporting documents.

policies.title: Grenada: Gambian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule directly lists The Gambia in its no-visa-required cohort for visitor travel.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Gambian passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule's no-visa category means a visa is not required; authorized stay, work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
